title: Fanout of non-output gates
statement: Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables, and compile it into a directed acyclic circuit. For any vertex $v$ with $n \le v < \mathrm{size}(c\text{ compiled})$ that is not the output vertex, the number of gates reading $v$ is exactly $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
$v$ is less than the compiled circuit's size
